title: HDAC Inhibitory and Anti-Cancer Activities of Curcumin and Curcumin Derivative CU17 against Human Lung Cancer A549 Cells.
authors: Namwan, Narissara; Senawong, Gulsiri; Phaosiri, Chanokbhorn; Kumboonma, Pakit; Somsakeesit, La-Or; Samankul, Arunta; Leerat, Chadaporn; Senawong, Thanaset
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素衍生物CU17对肺癌细胞的HDAC抑制与抗癌活性，涉及分子对接但对象为HDAC酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Previous research reported that the curcumin derivative (CU17) inhibited several cancer cell growths in vitro. However, its anticancer potential against human lung cancer cells (A549 cell lines) has not yet been evaluated. The purpose of this research was to examine the HDAC inhibitory and anti-cancer activities of CU17 compared to curcumin (CU) in A549 cells. An in vitro study showed that CU17 had greater HDAC inhibitory activity than CU. CU17 inhibited HDAC activity in a dose dependent manner with the half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC(50)) value of 0.30 +/- 0.086 microg/mL against HDAC enzymes from HeLa nuclear extract. In addition, CU17 could bind at the active pockets of both human class I HDACs (HDAC1, 2, 3, and 8) and class II HDACs (HDAC4, 6, and 7) demonstrated by molecular docking studies, and caused hyperacetylation of histone H3 (Ac-H3) in A549 cells shown by Western blot analysis. MTT assay indicated that both CU and CU17 suppressed A549 cell growth in a dose- and time-dependent manner. Besides, CU and CU17 induced G2/M phase cell cycle arrest and p53-independent apoptosis in A549 cells. Both CU and CU17 down-regulated the expression of p53, p21, Bcl-2, and pERK1/2, but up-regulated Bax expression in this cell line. Although CU17 inhibited the growth of lung cancer cells less effectively than CU, it showed less toxicity than CU for non-cancer cells. Accordingly, CU17 is a promising agent for lung cancer treatment. Additionally, CU17 synergized the antiproliferative activity of Gem in A549 cells, indicating the possibility of employing CU17 as an adjuvant treatment to enhance the chemotherapeutic effect of Gem in lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 前期研究报道姜黄素衍生物（CU17）在体外抑制多种癌细胞生长，但其对人肺癌细胞（A549细胞系）的抗癌潜力尚未评估。本研究旨在比较CU17与姜黄素（CU）在A549细胞中的HDAC抑制活性和抗癌活性。体外研究表明，CU17的HDAC抑制活性高于CU。CU17以剂量依赖性方式抑制HDAC活性，对HeLa核提取物中HDAC酶的半抑制浓度（IC(50)）值为0.30 ± 0.086微克/毫升。此外，分子对接研究显示，CU17能结合于人I类HDACs（HDAC1、2、3和8）及II类HDACs（HDAC4、6和7）的活性口袋，并通过Western blot分析证实其在A549细胞中引起组蛋白H3高乙酰化（Ac-H3）。MTT实验表明，CU和CU17均以剂量和时间依赖性方式抑制A549细胞生长。此外，CU和CU17在A549细胞中诱导G2/M期细胞周期阻滞和p53非依赖性凋亡。CU和CU17均下调p53、p21、Bcl-2和pERK1/2的表达，但上调Bax表达。尽管CU17抑制肺癌细胞生长的效果不如CU，但其对非癌细胞的毒性低于CU。因此，CU17是肺癌治疗的有前景候选药物。此外，CU17在A549细胞中与吉西他滨（Gem）的抗增殖活性具有协同作用，表明CU17可能作为辅助治疗手段，增强Gem在肺癌中的化疗效果。
